title: Account Identity Change
description: A requested operator-identity change that has not been applied. The account's top-level operator and operator_unit remain canonical until this object disappears after approval and the canonical fields advance. Rejected changes remain visible until replaced by a later request so buyers polling list_accounts can observe the outcome.

status.description: pending_approval means the seller is reviewing the requested transition; rejected means the current canonical identity was retained.

requested_operator_identity.description: Complete desired operator identity submitted by the buyer.

requested_at.description: When the seller recorded the request.

reason.description: Human-readable rejection reason. Required when status is rejected.
